AcceptInboundConnection.name: AcceptInboundConnection
AcceptInboundConnection.doc: Allows the destination Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to accept an inbound cross-cluster search connection request. For more information, see Cross-cluster search for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

AddDataSource.name: AddDataSource
AddDataSource.doc: Creates a new direct-query data source to the specified domain. For more information, see Creating Amazon OpenSearch Service data source integrations with Amazon S3.

AddDirectQueryDataSource.name: AddDirectQueryDataSource
AddDirectQueryDataSource.doc: Adds a new data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service so that you can perform direct queries on external data.

AddTags.name: AddTags
AddTags.doc: Attaches tags to an existing Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application. Tags are a set of case-sensitive key-value pairs. A domain, data source, or application can have up to 10 tags. For more information, see Tagging Amazon OpenSearch Service resources.

AssociatePackage.name: AssociatePackage
AssociatePackage.doc: Associates a package with an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

AssociatePackages.name: AssociatePackages
AssociatePackages.doc: Operation in the Amazon OpenSearch Service API for associating multiple packages with a domain simultaneously.

AttachDataSource.name: AttachDataSource
AttachDataSource.doc: Attaches a data source to an OpenSearch application. The data source can be an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain or an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection. If both the application and data source are in the ACTIVE state, the attachment completes immediately and returns a status of ATTACHED. If either resource is not yet active, the operation stores the request and returns a status of PENDING.…

AuthorizeVpcEndpointAccess.name: AuthorizeVpcEndpointAccess
AuthorizeVpcEndpointAccess.doc: Provides access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

CancelDomainConfigChange.name: CancelDomainConfigChange
CancelDomainConfigChange.doc: Cancels a pending configuration change on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

CancelServiceSoftwareUpdate.name: CancelServiceSoftwareUpdate
CancelServiceSoftwareUpdate.doc: Cancels a scheduled service software update for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. You can only perform this operation before the AutomatedUpdateDate and when the domain's UpdateStatus is PENDING_UPDATE. For more information, see Service software updates in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

CreateApplication.name: CreateApplication
CreateApplication.doc: Creates an OpenSearch UI application. For more information, see Using the OpenSearch user interface in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

CreateDomain.name: CreateDomain
CreateDomain.doc: Creates an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Creating and managing Amazon OpenSearch Service domains.

CreateIndex.name: CreateIndex
CreateIndex.doc: Creates an OpenSearch index with optional automatic semantic enrichment for specified text fields. Automatic semantic enrichment enables semantic search capabilities without requiring machine learning expertise, improving search relevance by up to 20% by understanding search intent and contextual meaning beyond keyword matching. The semantic enrichment process has zero impact on search latency as…

CreateOutboundConnection.name: CreateOutboundConnection
CreateOutboundConnection.doc: Creates a new cross-cluster search connection from a source Amazon OpenSearch Service domain to a destination domain. For more information, see Cross-cluster search for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

CreatePackage.name: CreatePackage
CreatePackage.doc: Creates a package for use with Amazon OpenSearch Service domains. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

CreateVpcEndpoint.name: CreateVpcEndpoint
CreateVpcEndpoint.doc: Creates an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoint.

DeleteDataSource.name: DeleteDataSource
DeleteDataSource.doc: Deletes a direct-query data source. For more information, see Deleting an Amazon OpenSearch Service data source with Amazon S3.

DeleteDirectQueryDataSource.name: DeleteDirectQueryDataSource
DeleteDirectQueryDataSource.doc: Deletes a previously configured direct query data source from Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DeleteDomain.name: DeleteDomain
DeleteDomain.doc: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain and all of its data. You can't recover a domain after you delete it.

DeleteInboundConnection.name: DeleteInboundConnection
DeleteInboundConnection.doc: Allows the destination Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to delete an existing inbound cross-cluster search connection. For more information, see Cross-cluster search for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DeleteIndex.name: DeleteIndex
DeleteIndex.doc: Deletes an OpenSearch index. This operation permanently removes the index and cannot be undone.

DeleteOutboundConnection.name: DeleteOutboundConnection
DeleteOutboundConnection.doc: Allows the source Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to delete an existing outbound cross-cluster search connection. For more information, see Cross-cluster search for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DeletePackage.name: DeletePackage
DeletePackage.doc: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service package. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DeleteVpcEndpoint.name: DeleteVpcEndpoint
DeleteVpcEndpoint.doc: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed interface VPC endpoint.

DeregisterCapability.name: DeregisterCapability
DeregisterCapability.doc: Deregisters a capability from an OpenSearch UI application. This operation removes the capability and its associated configuration.

DescribeDataSourceAttachment.name: DescribeDataSourceAttachment
DescribeDataSourceAttachment.doc: Returns the current status and details of a specific data source attachment for an OpenSearch application. Throws a ResourceNotFoundException if no attachment record exists for the specified application and data source combination.

DescribeDomain.name: DescribeDomain
DescribeDomain.doc: Describes the domain configuration for the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, including the domain ID, domain service endpoint, and domain ARN.

DescribeDomainAutoTunes.name: DescribeDomainAutoTunes
DescribeDomainAutoTunes.doc: Returns the list of optimizations that Auto-Tune has made to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribeDomainChangeProgress.name: DescribeDomainChangeProgress
DescribeDomainChangeProgress.doc: Returns information about the current blue/green deployment happening on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Making configuration changes in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribeDomainConfig.name: DescribeDomainConfig
DescribeDomainConfig.doc: Returns the configuration of an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

DescribeDomainHealth.name: DescribeDomainHealth
DescribeDomainHealth.doc: Returns information about domain and node health, the standby Availability Zone, number of nodes per Availability Zone, and shard count per node.

DescribeDomainNodes.name: DescribeDomainNodes
DescribeDomainNodes.doc: Returns information about domain and nodes, including data nodes, master nodes, ultrawarm nodes, Availability Zone(s), standby nodes, node configurations, and node states.

DescribeDomains.name: DescribeDomains
DescribeDomains.doc: Returns domain configuration information about the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domains.

DescribeDryRunProgress.name: DescribeDryRunProgress
DescribeDryRunProgress.doc: Describes the progress of a pre-update dry run analysis on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Determining whether a change will cause a blue/green deployment.

DescribeInboundConnections.name: DescribeInboundConnections
DescribeInboundConnections.doc: Lists all the inbound cross-cluster search connections for a destination (remote) Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Cross-cluster search for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribeInsightDetails.name: DescribeInsightDetails
DescribeInsightDetails.doc: Describes the details of an existing insight for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. Returns detailed fields associated with the specified insight, such as text descriptions and metric data.

DescribeInstanceTypeLimits.name: DescribeInstanceTypeLimits
DescribeInstanceTypeLimits.doc: Describes the instance count, storage, and master node limits for a given OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version and instance type.

DescribeOutboundConnections.name: DescribeOutboundConnections
DescribeOutboundConnections.doc: Lists all the outbound cross-cluster connections for a local (source) Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Cross-cluster search for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribePackages.name: DescribePackages
DescribePackages.doc: Describes all packages available to OpenSearch Service. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribeReservedInstanceOfferings.name: DescribeReservedInstanceOfferings
DescribeReservedInstanceOfferings.doc: Describes the available Amazon OpenSearch Service Reserved Instance offerings for a given Region. For more information, see Reserved Instances in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribeReservedInstances.name: DescribeReservedInstances
DescribeReservedInstances.doc: Describes the Amazon OpenSearch Service instances that you have reserved in a given Region. For more information, see Reserved Instances in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DescribeVpcEndpoints.name: DescribeVpcEndpoints
DescribeVpcEndpoints.doc: Describes one or more Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints.

DetachDataSource.name: DetachDataSource
DetachDataSource.doc: Removes a data source from an OpenSearch application. The application must be in the ACTIVE state. This operation removes the data source saved object from the application and deletes the attachment record. Throws a ConflictException if the specified data source has a PENDING attachment, and a ResourceNotFoundException if the data source is not currently attached to the application.

DissociatePackage.name: DissociatePackage
DissociatePackage.doc: Removes a package from the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. The package can't be in use with any OpenSearch index for the dissociation to succeed. The package is still available in OpenSearch Service for association later. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DissociatePackages.name: DissociatePackages
DissociatePackages.doc: Dissociates multiple packages from a domain simultaneously.

GetApplication.name: GetApplication
GetApplication.doc: Retrieves the configuration and status of an existing OpenSearch application.

GetCapability.name: GetCapability
GetCapability.doc: Retrieves information about a registered capability for an OpenSearch UI application, including its configuration and current status.

GetCompatibleVersions.name: GetCompatibleVersions
GetCompatibleVersions.doc: Returns a map of OpenSearch or Elasticsearch versions and the versions you can upgrade them to.

GetDataSource.name: GetDataSource
GetDataSource.doc: Retrieves information about a direct query data source.

GetDefaultApplicationSetting.name: GetDefaultApplicationSetting
GetDefaultApplicationSetting.doc: Gets the ARN of the current default application. If the default application isn't set, the operation returns a resource not found error.

GetDirectQueryDataSource.name: GetDirectQueryDataSource
GetDirectQueryDataSource.doc: Returns detailed configuration information for a specific direct query data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

GetDomainMaintenanceStatus.name: GetDomainMaintenanceStatus
GetDomainMaintenanceStatus.doc: The status of the maintenance action.

GetIndex.name: GetIndex
GetIndex.doc: Retrieves information about an OpenSearch index including its schema and semantic enrichment configuration. Use this operation to view the current index structure and semantic search settings.

GetMigration.name: GetMigration
GetMigration.doc: Retrieves the current status and progress of a migration job, including the number of exported and imported objects and error details if the migration failed.

GetPackageVersionHistory.name: GetPackageVersionHistory
GetPackageVersionHistory.doc: Returns a list of Amazon OpenSearch Service package versions, along with their creation time, commit message, and plugin properties (if the package is a zip plugin package). For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

GetUpgradeHistory.name: GetUpgradeHistory
GetUpgradeHistory.doc: Retrieves the complete history of the last 10 upgrades performed on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

GetUpgradeStatus.name: GetUpgradeStatus
GetUpgradeStatus.doc: Returns the most recent status of the last upgrade or upgrade eligibility check performed on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

InsightFeedback.name: InsightFeedback
InsightFeedback.doc: Submits feedback for an existing insight in an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. Allows users to provide a thumbs up or thumbs down rating and optional text feedback for a specific insight.

ListApplications.name: ListApplications
ListApplications.doc: Lists all OpenSearch applications under your account.

ListDataSourceAttachments.name: ListDataSourceAttachments
ListDataSourceAttachments.doc: Returns a paginated list of all data source attachments for an OpenSearch application, including attachments in all states (PENDING, ATTACHED, and FAILED).

ListDataSources.name: ListDataSources
ListDataSources.doc: Lists direct-query data sources for a specific domain. For more information, see For more information, see Working with Amazon OpenSearch Service direct queries with Amazon S3.

ListDirectQueryDataSources.name: ListDirectQueryDataSources
ListDirectQueryDataSources.doc: Lists an inventory of all the direct query data sources that you have configured within Amazon OpenSearch Service.

ListDomainMaintenances.name: ListDomainMaintenances
ListDomainMaintenances.doc: A list of maintenance actions for the domain.

ListDomainNames.name: ListDomainNames
ListDomainNames.doc: Returns the names of all Amazon OpenSearch Service domains owned by the current user in the active Region.

ListDomainsForPackage.name: ListDomainsForPackage
ListDomainsForPackage.doc: Lists all Amazon OpenSearch Service domains associated with a given package. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

ListInsights.name: ListInsights
ListInsights.doc: Lists insights for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain or Amazon Web Services account. Returns a paginated list of insights based on the specified entity, filters, time range, and sort order.

ListInstanceTypeDetails.name: ListInstanceTypeDetails
ListInstanceTypeDetails.doc: Lists all instance types and available features for a given OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version.

ListMigrations.name: ListMigrations
ListMigrations.doc: Lists migration jobs for an Amazon OpenSearch Service application. You can filter results by migration status. Use pagination to ensure that the operation returns quickly and successfully.

ListPackagesForDomain.name: ListPackagesForDomain
ListPackagesForDomain.doc: Lists all packages associated with an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

ListScheduledActions.name: ListScheduledActions
ListScheduledActions.doc: Retrieves a list of configuration changes that are scheduled for a domain. These changes can be service software updates or blue/green Auto-Tune enhancements.

ListTags.name: ListTags
ListTags.doc: Returns all resource tags for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application. For more information, see Tagging Amazon OpenSearch Service resources.

ListVersions.name: ListVersions
ListVersions.doc: Lists all versions of OpenSearch and Elasticsearch that Amazon OpenSearch Service supports.

ListVpcEndpointAccess.name: ListVpcEndpointAccess
ListVpcEndpointAccess.doc: Retrieves information about each Amazon Web Services principal that is allowed to access a given Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

ListVpcEndpoints.name: ListVpcEndpoints
ListVpcEndpoints.doc: Retrieves all Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints in the current Amazon Web Services account and Region.

ListVpcEndpointsForDomain.name: ListVpcEndpointsForDomain
ListVpcEndpointsForDomain.doc: Retrieves all Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints associated with a particular domain.

PurchaseReservedInstanceOffering.name: PurchaseReservedInstanceOffering
PurchaseReservedInstanceOffering.doc: Allows you to purchase Amazon OpenSearch Service Reserved Instances.

PutDefaultApplicationSetting.name: PutDefaultApplicationSetting
PutDefaultApplicationSetting.doc: Sets the default application to the application with the specified ARN. To remove the default application, use the GetDefaultApplicationSetting operation to get the current default and then call the PutDefaultApplicationSetting with the current applications ARN and the setAsDefault parameter set to false.

RegisterCapability.name: RegisterCapability
RegisterCapability.doc: Registers a capability for an OpenSearch UI application. Use this operation to enable specific capabilities, such as AI features, for a given application. The capability configuration defines the type and settings of the capability to register. For more information about the AI features, see Agentic AI for OpenSearch UI.

RejectInboundConnection.name: RejectInboundConnection
RejectInboundConnection.doc: Allows the remote Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to reject an inbound cross-cluster connection request.

RemoveTags.name: RemoveTags
RemoveTags.doc: Removes the specified set of tags from an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application. For more information, see Tagging Amazon OpenSearch Service resources.

RevokeVpcEndpointAccess.name: RevokeVpcEndpointAccess
RevokeVpcEndpointAccess.doc: Revokes access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain that was provided through an interface VPC endpoint.

RollbackServiceSoftwareUpdate.name: RollbackServiceSoftwareUpdate
RollbackServiceSoftwareUpdate.doc: Rolls back a service software update for a domain to the previous version. For more information, see Service software updates in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

StartDomainMaintenance.name: StartDomainMaintenance
StartDomainMaintenance.doc: Starts the node maintenance process on the data node. These processes can include a node reboot, an Opensearch or Elasticsearch process restart, or a Dashboard or Kibana restart.

StartMigration.name: StartMigration
StartMigration.doc: Initiates a migration job to migrate saved objects from a data source to an Amazon OpenSearch Service application workspace. Saved objects include dashboards, visualizations, index patterns, and searches. You can specify export filters to control the scope of the migration and a conflict resolution strategy for handling existing objects in the target workspace.

StartServiceSoftwareUpdate.name: StartServiceSoftwareUpdate
StartServiceSoftwareUpdate.doc: Schedules a service software update for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Service software updates in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

UpdateApplication.name: UpdateApplication
UpdateApplication.doc: Updates the configuration and settings of an existing OpenSearch application.

UpdateDataSource.name: UpdateDataSource
UpdateDataSource.doc: Updates a direct-query data source. For more information, see Working with Amazon OpenSearch Service data source integrations with Amazon S3.

UpdateDirectQueryDataSource.name: UpdateDirectQueryDataSource
UpdateDirectQueryDataSource.doc: Updates the configuration or properties of an existing direct query data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

UpdateDomainConfig.name: UpdateDomainConfig
UpdateDomainConfig.doc: Modifies the cluster configuration of the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

UpdateIndex.name: UpdateIndex
UpdateIndex.doc: Updates an existing OpenSearch index schema and semantic enrichment configuration. This operation allows modification of field mappings and semantic search settings for text fields. Changes to semantic enrichment configuration will apply to newly ingested documents.

UpdatePackage.name: UpdatePackage
UpdatePackage.doc: Updates a package for use with Amazon OpenSearch Service domains. For more information, see Custom packages for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

UpdatePackageScope.name: UpdatePackageScope
UpdatePackageScope.doc: Updates the scope of a package. Scope of the package defines users who can view and associate a package.

UpdateScheduledAction.name: UpdateScheduledAction
UpdateScheduledAction.doc: Reschedules a planned domain configuration change for a later time. This change can be a scheduled service software update or a blue/green Auto-Tune enhancement.

UpdateVpcEndpoint.name: UpdateVpcEndpoint
UpdateVpcEndpoint.doc: Modifies an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed interface VPC endpoint.

UpgradeDomain.name: UpgradeDomain
UpgradeDomain.doc: Allows you to either upgrade your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain or perform an upgrade eligibility check to a compatible version of OpenSearch or Elasticsearch.

AIConfig.doc: Configuration settings for AI-powered capabilities of an OpenSearch UI application.

NaturalLanguageQueryGenerationOptions.doc: Container for parameters required for natural language query generation on the specified domain.

S3VectorsEngine.doc: Container for parameters required to enable S3 vectors engine features on the specified domain.

ServerlessVectorAcceleration.doc: Specifies whether to enable serverless vector acceleration for the domain. When enabled, provides GPU-accelerated vector search capabilities for improved performance on vector workloads.

AIMLOptionsInput.doc: Container for parameters required to enable all machine learning features.

NaturalLanguageQueryGenerationOptions.doc: Container for parameters required for natural language query generation on the specified domain.

S3VectorsEngine.doc: Container for parameters representing the state of S3 vectors engine features on the specified domain.

ServerlessVectorAcceleration.doc: The current serverless vector acceleration configuration for the domain.

AIMLOptionsOutput.doc: Container for parameters representing the state of machine learning features on the specified domain.

Options.doc: Machine learning options on the specified domain.

AIMLOptionsStatus.doc: The status of machine learning options on the specified domain.

ARN.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain. See Identifiers for IAM Entities in Using Amazon Web Services Identity and Access Management for more information.

OwnerId.doc: The Amazon Web Services account ID of the domain owner.

DomainName.doc: Name of the domain.

Region.doc: The Amazon Web Services Region in which the domain is located.

AWSDomainInformation.doc: Information about an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

ConnectionId.doc: The ID of the inbound connection to accept.

AcceptInboundConnectionRequest.doc: Container for the parameters to the AcceptInboundConnection operation.

Connection.doc: Information about the accepted inbound connection.

AcceptInboundConnectionResponse.doc: Contains details about the accepted inbound connection.

Options.doc: The access policy configured for the domain. Access policies can be resource-based, IP-based, or IAM-based. For more information, see Configuring access policies.

Status.doc: The status of the access policy for the domain.

AccessPoliciesStatus.doc: The configured access rules for the domain's search endpoint, and the current status of those rules.

DomainName.doc: The name of the domain to add the data source to.

Name.doc: A name for the data source.

Description.doc: A description of the data source.

AddDataSourceRequest.doc: Container for the parameters to the AddDataSource operation.

Message.doc: A message associated with creation of the data source.

AddDataSourceResponse.doc: The result of an AddDataSource operation.

DataSourceName.doc: A unique, user-defined label to identify the data source within your OpenSearch Service environment.

DataSourceType.doc: The supported Amazon Web Services service that you want to use as the source for direct queries in OpenSearch Service.

Description.doc: An optional text field for providing additional context and details about the data source.

OpenSearchArns.doc: An optional list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) for the OpenSearch collections that are associated with the direct query data source. This field is required for CloudWatchLogs and SecurityLake datasource types.

DataSourceAccessPolicy.doc: An optional IAM access policy document that defines the permissions for accessing the data source. The policy document must be in valid JSON format and follow IAM policy syntax.

DataSourceArn.doc: The unique, system-generated identifier that represents the data source.

ARN.doc: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application to which you want to attach resource tags.

AddTagsRequest.doc: Container for the parameters to the AddTags operation. Specifies the tags to attach to the domain, data source, or application.

LimitName.doc: MaximumNumberOfDataNodesSupported - This attribute only applies to master nodes and specifies the maximum number of data nodes of a given instance type a master node can support. MaximumNumberOfDataNodesWithoutMasterNode - This attribute only applies to data nodes and specifies the maximum number of data nodes of a given instance type can exist without a master node governing them.

LimitValues.doc: The values of the additional instance type limits.

AdditionalLimit.doc: List of limits that are specific to a given instance type.

AdvancedOptions.doc: Exposes native OpenSearch configuration values from opensearch.yml. The following advanced options are available: Allows references to indexes in an HTTP request body. Must be false when configuring access to individual sub-resources. Default is true. Specifies the percentage of heap space allocated to field data. Default is unbounded. For more information, see Advanced cluster parameters.

Options.doc: The status of advanced options for the specified domain.

Status.doc: The status of advanced options for the specified domain.

AdvancedOptionsStatus.doc: Status of the advanced options for the specified domain. The following options are available: "rest.action.multi.allow_explicit_index": "true" | "false" - Note the use of a string rather than a boolean. Specifies whether explicit references to indexes are allowed inside the body of HTTP requests. If you want to configure access policies for domain sub-resources, such as specific indexes and…

Enabled.doc: True if fine-grained access control is enabled.

InternalUserDatabaseEnabled.doc: True if the internal user database is enabled.

SAMLOptions.doc: Container for information about the SAML configuration for OpenSearch Dashboards.

JWTOptions.doc: Container for information about the JWT configuration of the Amazon OpenSearch Service.

IAMFederationOptions.doc: Configuration options for IAM identity federation in advanced security settings.

AnonymousAuthDisableDate.doc: Date and time when the migration period will be disabled. Only necessary when enabling fine-grained access control on an existing domain.

AnonymousAuthEnabled.doc: True if a 30-day migration period is enabled, during which administrators can create role mappings. Only necessary when enabling fine-grained access control on an existing domain.

AdvancedSecurityOptions.doc: Container for fine-grained access control settings.

Enabled.doc: True to enable fine-grained access control.

InternalUserDatabaseEnabled.doc: True to enable the internal user database.

MasterUserOptions.doc: Container for information about the master user.

SAMLOptions.doc: Container for information about the SAML configuration for OpenSearch Dashboards.

JWTOptions.doc: Container for information about the JWT configuration of the Amazon OpenSearch Service.

IAMFederationOptions.doc: Input configuration for IAM identity federation within advanced security options.

AnonymousAuthEnabled.doc: True to enable a 30-day migration period during which administrators can create role mappings. Only necessary when enabling fine-grained access control on an existing domain.

AdvancedSecurityOptionsInput.doc: Options for enabling and configuring fine-grained access control. For more information, see Fine-grained access control in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

Options.doc: Container for fine-grained access control settings.

Status.doc: Status of the fine-grained access control settings for a domain.

AdvancedSecurityOptionsStatus.doc: The status of fine-grained access control settings for a domain.

key.doc: The configuration item to set, such as the admin role for the OpenSearch application.

value.doc: The value assigned to the configuration key, such as an IAM user ARN.

AppConfig.doc: Configuration settings for an OpenSearch application. For more information, see Using the OpenSearch user interface in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

id.doc: The unique identifier of an OpenSearch application.

name.doc: The name of an OpenSearch application.

endpoint.doc: The endpoint URL of an OpenSearch application.

status.doc: The current status of an OpenSearch application. Possible values: CREATING, UPDATING, DELETING, FAILED, ACTIVE, and DELETED.

createdAt.doc: The timestamp when an OpenSearch application was created.

lastUpdatedAt.doc: The timestamp of the last update to an OpenSearch application.

ApplicationSummary.doc: Basic details of an OpenSearch application.

PackageID.doc: Internal ID of the package to associate with a domain. Use DescribePackages to find this value.

DomainName.doc: Name of the domain to associate the package with.

PrerequisitePackageIDList.doc: A list of package IDs that must be associated with the domain before the package specified in the request can be associated.

AssociationConfiguration.doc: The configuration for associating a package with an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

AssociatePackageRequest.doc: Container for the request parameters to the AssociatePackage operation.

DomainPackageDetails.doc: Information about a package that is associated with a domain.

AssociatePackageResponse.doc: Container for the response returned by the AssociatePackage operation.

PackageList.doc: A list of packages and their prerequisites to be associated with a domain.

DomainPackageDetailsList.doc: List of information about packages that are associated with a domain.

id.doc: The unique identifier or name of the OpenSearch application to attach the data source to. This is the same identifier used with UpdateApplication, GetApplication, and DeleteApplication.

workspaceId.doc: The identifier of an existing workspace to update with the new data source. Mutually exclusive with workspaceConfiguration.

workspaceConfiguration.doc: Configuration for creating a new workspace during the attachment. If specified, a workspace is created and linked to the data source after the attachment completes. Mutually exclusive with workspaceId.

clientToken.doc: A unique, case-sensitive identifier to ensure idempotency of the request. If you retry a request with the same client token and the same parameters, the retry succeeds without performing any further actions.

attachmentId.doc: The unique identifier assigned to the data source attachment.

id.doc: The unique identifier of the OpenSearch application.

status.doc: The status of the data source attachment. Valid values are PENDING (waiting for resources to become active), ATTACHED (successfully attached), and FAILED (attachment timed out or encountered a non-retryable error).

DomainName.doc: The name of the OpenSearch Service domain to provide access to.

Account.doc: The Amazon Web Services account ID to grant access to.

Service.doc: The Amazon Web Services service SP to grant access to.

ServiceOptions.doc: The options for the service, including the supported Regions for the endpoint access.

AuthorizedPrincipal.doc: Information about the Amazon Web Services account or service that was provided access to the domain.

Principal.doc: The IAM principal that is allowed access to the domain.

ServiceOptions.doc: The options for the service, including the supported Regions for the endpoint access.

AuthorizedPrincipal.doc: Information about an Amazon Web Services account or service that has access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

AutoTune.doc: Information about an Auto-Tune action. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

AutoTuneDate.doc: The timestamp of the Auto-Tune action scheduled for the domain.

AutoTuneDesiredState.doc: The Auto-Tune desired state. Valid values are ENABLED and DISABLED.

ScheduledAutoTuneDetails.doc: Container for details about a scheduled Auto-Tune action.

AutoTuneDetails.doc: Specifies details about a scheduled Auto-Tune action. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

StartAt.doc: The Epoch timestamp at which the Auto-Tune maintenance schedule starts.

Duration.doc: The duration of the maintenance schedule. For example, "Duration": {"Value": 2, "Unit": "HOURS"}.

CronExpressionForRecurrence.doc: A cron expression for a recurring maintenance schedule during which Auto-Tune can deploy changes.

AutoTuneMaintenanceSchedule.doc: This object is deprecated. Use the domain's off-peak window to schedule Auto-Tune optimizations. For migration instructions, see Migrating from Auto-Tune maintenance windows. The Auto-Tune maintenance schedule. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DesiredState.doc: Whether Auto-Tune is enabled or disabled.

RollbackOnDisable.doc: When disabling Auto-Tune, specify NO_ROLLBACK to retain all prior Auto-Tune settings or DEFAULT_ROLLBACK to revert to the OpenSearch Service defaults. If you specify DEFAULT_ROLLBACK, you must include a MaintenanceSchedule in the request. Otherwise, OpenSearch Service is unable to perform the rollback.

MaintenanceSchedules.doc: DEPRECATED. Use off-peak window instead. A list of maintenance schedules during which Auto-Tune can deploy changes.

UseOffPeakWindow.doc: Whether to use the domain's off-peak window to deploy configuration changes on the domain rather than a maintenance schedule.

AutoTuneOptions.doc: Auto-Tune settings when updating a domain. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

DesiredState.doc: Whether Auto-Tune is enabled or disabled.

MaintenanceSchedules.doc: A list of maintenance schedules during which Auto-Tune can deploy changes. Maintenance windows are deprecated and have been replaced with off-peak windows.

UseOffPeakWindow.doc: Whether to schedule Auto-Tune optimizations that require blue/green deployments during the domain's configured daily off-peak window.

AutoTuneOptionsInput.doc: Options for configuring Auto-Tune. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service

State.doc: The current state of Auto-Tune on the domain.

ErrorMessage.doc: Any errors that occurred while enabling or disabling Auto-Tune.

UseOffPeakWindow.doc: Whether the domain's off-peak window will be used to deploy Auto-Tune changes rather than a maintenance schedule.

AutoTuneOptionsOutput.doc: The Auto-Tune settings for a domain, displayed when enabling or disabling Auto-Tune.

Options.doc: Auto-Tune settings for updating a domain.

Status.doc: The current status of Auto-Tune for a domain.

AutoTuneOptionsStatus.doc: The Auto-Tune status for the domain.

SubjectKey.doc: The key used for matching the SAML subject attribute.

RolesKey.doc: The key used for matching the SAML roles attribute.

SessionTimeoutMinutes.doc: The duration, in minutes, after which a user session becomes inactive.

SAMLOptionsOutput.doc: Describes the SAML application configured for the domain.

type.doc: The type of the saved object, such as dashboard, visualization, index-pattern, search, or query.

id.doc: The unique identifier of the saved object.

SavedObjectIdentifier.doc: Identifies a specific saved object by its type and unique identifier.

Id.doc: The unique identifier of the scheduled action.

Type.doc: The type of action that will be taken on the domain.

ScheduledTime.doc: The time when the change is scheduled to happen.

Description.doc: A description of the action to be taken.

ScheduledBy.doc: Whether the action was scheduled manually (CUSTOMER, or by OpenSearch Service automatically (SYSTEM).

Status.doc: The current status of the scheduled action.

Mandatory.doc: Whether the action is required or optional.

Cancellable.doc: Whether or not the scheduled action is cancellable.

ScheduledAction.doc: Information about a scheduled configuration change for an OpenSearch Service domain. This actions can be a service software update or a blue/green Auto-Tune enhancement.

ScheduledAutoTuneDescription.doc: The description of an Auto-Tune maintenance action that occurs on a domain.

Date.doc: The date and time when the Auto-Tune action is scheduled for the domain.

Action.doc: A description of the Auto-Tune action.

Severity.doc: The severity of the Auto-Tune action. Valid values are LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH.

ScheduledAutoTuneDetails.doc: Specifies details about a scheduled Auto-Tune action. For more information, see Auto-Tune for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

RoleArn.doc: The unique identifier of the IAM role that grants OpenSearch Service permission to access the specified data source.

SecurityLakeDirectQueryDataSource.doc: Configuration details for a Security Lake data source that can be used for direct queries.

Enabled.doc: Specifies whether serverless vector acceleration is enabled for the domain.

ServerlessVectorAcceleration.doc: Configuration for serverless vector acceleration, which provides GPU-accelerated vector search capabilities for improved performance on vector workloads.

SupportedRegions.doc: The list of supported Regions for the service.

ServiceOptions.doc: Options for the service, such as the supported Regions.

CurrentVersion.doc: The current service software version present on the domain.

NewVersion.doc: The new service software version, if one is available.

UpdateAvailable.doc: True if you're able to update your service software version. False if you can't update your service software version.

Cancellable.doc: True if you're able to cancel your service software version update. False if you can't cancel your service software update.

UpdateStatus.doc: The status of your service software update.

Description.doc: A description of the service software update status.

AutomatedUpdateDate.doc: The timestamp, in Epoch time, until which you can manually request a service software update. After this date, we automatically update your service software.

OptionalDeployment.doc: True if a service software is never automatically updated. False if a service software is automatically updated after the automated update date.

ServiceSoftwareOptions.doc: The current status of the service software for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For more information, see Service software updates in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

ServiceUrl.doc: The domain endpoint to which index and search requests are submitted. For example, search-imdb-movies-oopcnjfn6ugo.eu-west-1.es.amazonaws.com or doc-imdb-movies-oopcnjfn6u.eu-west-1.es.amazonaws.com.

SkipUnavailableStatus.doc: The status of SkipUnavailable setting for the outbound connection. ENABLED - The SkipUnavailable setting is enabled for the connection. DISABLED - The SkipUnavailable setting is disabled for the connection.

AutomatedSnapshotStartHour.doc: The time, in UTC format, when OpenSearch Service takes a daily automated snapshot of the specified domain. Default is 0 hours.

SnapshotOptions.doc: The time, in UTC format, when OpenSearch Service takes a daily automated snapshot of the specified domain. Default is 0 hours.

Options.doc: The daily snapshot options specified for the domain.

Status.doc: The status of a daily automated snapshot.

SnapshotOptionsStatus.doc: Container for information about a daily automated snapshot for an OpenSearch Service domain.

AutoSoftwareUpdateEnabled.doc: Whether automatic service software updates are enabled for the domain.

UseLatestServiceSoftwareForBlueGreen.doc: Whether the domain should use the latest service software version during a blue/green deployment. If enabled, the domain will automatically use the latest available service software when a blue/green deployment is triggered.

SoftwareUpdateOptions.doc: Options for configuring service software updates for a domain.

Options.doc: The service software update options for a domain.

Status.doc: The status of service software update options, including creation date and last updated date.

SoftwareUpdateOptionsStatus.doc: The status of the service software options for a domain.

DomainName.doc: The name of the domain.

NodeId.doc: The ID of the data node.

StartDomainMaintenanceRequest.doc: Container for the parameters to the StartDomainMaintenance operation.

MaintenanceId.doc: The request ID of requested action.

StartDomainMaintenanceResponse.doc: The result of a StartDomainMaintenance request that information about the requested action.

applicationId.doc: The unique identifier of the OpenSearch application to migrate saved objects into.

migrationOptions.doc: The configuration options for the migration, including the source data source, target workspace, export filters, and conflict resolution strategy.

clientToken.doc: A unique, case-sensitive identifier to ensure that the operation completes no more than one time. If this token matches a previous request, Amazon OpenSearch Service ignores the request but does not return an error.

migrationId.doc: The unique identifier of the migration job.

status.doc: The initial status of the migration job. The status is PENDING when a migration is first created.

DomainName.doc: The name of the domain that you want to update to the latest service software.

ScheduleAt.doc: When to start the service software update. NOW - Immediately schedules the update to happen in the current hour if there's capacity available. TIMESTAMP - Lets you specify a custom date and time to apply the update. If you specify this value, you must also provide a value for DesiredStartTime. DesiredStartTime.doc: The Epoch timestamp when you want the service software update to start. You only need to specify this parameter if you set ScheduleAt to TIMESTAMP.

StartServiceSoftwareUpdateRequest.doc: Container for the request parameters to the StartServiceSoftwareUpdate operation.

ServiceSoftwareOptions.doc: The current status of the OpenSearch Service software update.

StartServiceSoftwareUpdateResponse.doc: Represents the output of a StartServiceSoftwareUpdate operation. Contains the status of the update.

StorageSubTypeName.doc: Sub-type of the given EBS storage type. List of available sub-storage options. The instance storage type has no storage sub-type. The ebs storage type has the following valid sub-types: standard gp2 gp3 io1

StorageTypeName.doc: The name of the storage type.

StorageSubTypeName.doc: The storage sub-type, such as gp3 or io1.

StorageTypeLimits.doc: Limits that are applicable for the given storage type.

StorageType.doc: A list of storage types for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain that are available for a given intance type.

LimitName.doc: Name of storage limits that are applicable for the given storage type. If StorageType is ebs, the following options are available: MinimumVolumeSize - Minimum volume size that is available for the given storage type. Can be empty if not applicable. MaximumVolumeSize - Maximum volume size that is available for the given storage type. Can be empty if not applicable. MaximumIops - Maximum amount of…

StorageTypeLimit.doc: Limits that are applicable for the given Amazon OpenSearch Service storage type.

StorageTypeName.doc: The type of storage that the domain uses. Can be one of the following: instance Built-in storage available for the instance. ebs Elastic Block Storage (EBS) attached to the instance.

Key.doc: The tag key. Tag keys must be unique for the domain to which they are attached.

Value.doc: The value assigned to the corresponding tag key. Tag values can be null and don't have to be unique in a tag set. For example, you can have a key value pair in a tag set of project : Trinity and cost-center : Trinity

Tag.doc: A tag (key-value pair) for an Amazon OpenSearch Service resource.

TagKey.doc: A string between 1 to 128 characters that specifies the key for a tag. Tag keys must be unique for the domain to which they're attached.

TagList.doc: A list of tags attached to a domain.

TagValue.doc: A string between 0 to 256 characters that specifies the value for a tag. Tag values can be null and don't have to be unique in a tag set.

TimeUnit.doc: The unit of a maintenance schedule duration. Valid value is HOUR.

id.doc: The unique identifier for the OpenSearch application to be updated.

dataSources.doc: The data sources to associate with the OpenSearch application.

appConfigs.doc: The configuration settings to modify for the OpenSearch application.

iamIdentityCenterOptions.doc: Configuration settings for integrating IAM Identity Center with the OpenSearch application.

id.doc: The unique identifier of the updated OpenSearch application.

name.doc: The name of the updated OpenSearch application.

dataSources.doc: The data sources associated with the updated OpenSearch application.

iamIdentityCenterOptions.doc: The IAM Identity Center configuration for the updated OpenSearch application.

appConfigs.doc: The configuration settings for the updated OpenSearch application.

createdAt.doc: The timestamp when the OpenSearch application was originally created.

lastUpdatedAt.doc: The timestamp when the OpenSearch application was last updated.

DomainName.doc: The name of the domain.

Name.doc: The name of the data source to modify.

Description.doc: A new description of the data source.

Status.doc: The status of the data source update.

UpdateDataSourceRequest.doc: Container for the parameters to the UpdateDataSource operation.

Message.doc: A message associated with the updated data source.

UpdateDataSourceResponse.doc: The result of an UpdateDataSource operation.

DataSourceName.doc: A unique, user-defined label to identify the data source within your OpenSearch Service environment.

DataSourceType.doc: The supported Amazon Web Services service that you want to use as the source for direct queries in OpenSearch Service.

Description.doc: An optional text field for providing additional context and details about the data source.

OpenSearchArns.doc: An optional list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) for the OpenSearch collections that are associated with the direct query data source. This field is required for CloudWatchLogs and SecurityLake datasource types.

DataSourceAccessPolicy.doc: An optional IAM access policy document that defines the updated permissions for accessing the direct query data source. The policy document must be in valid JSON format and follow IAM policy syntax. If not specified, the existing access policy if present remains unchanged.

DataSourceArn.doc: The unique, system-generated identifier that represents the data source.

DomainName.doc: The name of the domain that you're updating.

ClusterConfig.doc: Changes that you want to make to the cluster configuration, such as the instance type and number of EC2 instances.

EBSOptions.doc: The type and size of the EBS volume to attach to instances in the domain.

SnapshotOptions.doc: Option to set the time, in UTC format, for the daily automated snapshot. Default value is 0 hours.

VPCOptions.doc: Options to specify the subnets and security groups for a VPC endpoint. For more information, see Launching your Amazon OpenSearch Service domains using a VPC.

CognitoOptions.doc: Key-value pairs to configure Amazon Cognito authentication for OpenSearch Dashboards.

AdvancedOptions.doc: Key-value pairs to specify advanced configuration options. The following key-value pairs are supported: "rest.action.multi.allow_explicit_index": "true" | "false" - Note the use of a string rather than a boolean. Specifies whether explicit references to indexes are allowed inside the body of HTTP requests. If you want to configure access policies for domain sub-resources, such as specific indexes…

AccessPolicies.doc: Identity and Access Management (IAM) access policy as a JSON-formatted string.

IPAddressType.doc: Specify either dual stack or IPv4 as your IP address type. Dual stack allows you to share domain resources across IPv4 and IPv6 address types, and is the recommended option. If your IP address type is currently set to dual stack, you can't change it.

LogPublishingOptions.doc: Options to publish OpenSearch logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.

EncryptionAtRestOptions.doc: Encryption at rest options for the domain.

DomainEndpointOptions.doc: Additional options for the domain endpoint, such as whether to require HTTPS for all traffic.

NodeToNodeEncryptionOptions.doc: Node-to-node encryption options for the domain.

DryRun.doc: This flag, when set to True, specifies whether the UpdateDomain request should return the results of a dry run analysis without actually applying the change. A dry run determines what type of deployment the update will cause.

DryRunMode.doc: The type of dry run to perform. Basic only returns the type of deployment (blue/green or dynamic) that the update will cause. Verbose runs an additional check to validate the changes you're making. For more information, see Validating a domain update.

OffPeakWindowOptions.doc: Off-peak window options for the domain.

SoftwareUpdateOptions.doc: Service software update options for the domain.

AIMLOptions.doc: Options for all machine learning features for the specified domain.

DeploymentStrategyOptions.doc: Specifies the deployment strategy options for the domain.

AutomatedSnapshotPauseOptions.doc: Specifies the automated snapshot pause options for the domain. Suspending snapshots reduces data protection. You cannot restore your domain to points in time when snapshots are suspended. Use this feature only for short-term operational needs such as migrations or maintenance windows. Maximum suspension duration: 3 days.

UseCase.doc: The primary use case for the domain. For valid values, see DomainUseCase.

EngineMode.doc: The engine mode for the domain. The engine mode can't be changed after the domain is created. For valid values, see EngineMode.

UpdateDomainConfigRequest.doc: Container for the request parameters to the UpdateDomain operation.

DomainConfig.doc: The status of the updated domain.

DryRunResults.doc: Results of the dry run performed in the update domain request.

DryRunProgressStatus.doc: The status of the dry run being performed on the domain, if any.

UpdateDomainConfigResponse.doc: The results of an UpdateDomain request. Contains the status of the domain being updated.

IndexName.doc: The name of the index to update.

IndexSchema.doc: The updated JSON schema for the index including any changes to mappings, settings, and semantic enrichment configuration.

Status.doc: The status of the index update operation.

PackageID.doc: The unique identifier for the package.

PackageSource.doc: Amazon S3 bucket and key for the package.

PackageDescription.doc: A new description of the package.

CommitMessage.doc: Commit message for the updated file, which is shown as part of GetPackageVersionHistoryResponse.

PackageConfiguration.doc: The updated configuration details for a package.

UpdatePackageRequest.doc: Container for request parameters to the UpdatePackage operation.

UpdatePackageResponse.doc: Container for the response returned by the UpdatePackage operation.

PackageID.doc: ID of the package whose scope is being updated.

Operation.doc: The operation to perform on the package scope (e.g., add/remove/override users).

PackageUserList.doc: List of users to be added or removed from the package scope.

PackageID.doc: ID of the package whose scope was updated.

Operation.doc: The operation that was performed on the package scope.

PackageUserList.doc: List of users who have access to the package after the scope update.

ActionID.doc: The unique identifier of the action to reschedule. To retrieve this ID, send a ListScheduledActions request.

ActionType.doc: The type of action to reschedule. Can be one of SERVICE_SOFTWARE_UPDATE, JVM_HEAP_SIZE_TUNING, or JVM_YOUNG_GEN_TUNING. To retrieve this value, send a ListScheduledActions request.

ScheduleAt.doc: When to schedule the action. NOW - Immediately schedules the update to happen in the current hour if there's capacity available. TIMESTAMP - Lets you specify a custom date and time to apply the update. If you specify this value, you must also provide a value for DesiredStartTime. DesiredStartTime.doc: The time to implement the change, in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Only specify this parameter if you set ScheduleAt to TIMESTAMP.

VpcEndpointId.doc: The unique identifier of the endpoint.

VpcOptions.doc: The security groups and/or subnets to add, remove, or modify.

DomainName.doc: Name of the OpenSearch Service domain that you want to upgrade.

TargetVersion.doc: OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version to which you want to upgrade, in the format Opensearch_X.Y or Elasticsearch_X.Y.

PerformCheckOnly.doc: When true, indicates that an upgrade eligibility check needs to be performed. Does not actually perform the upgrade.

AdvancedOptions.doc: Only supports the override_main_response_version parameter and not other advanced options. You can only include this option when upgrading to an OpenSearch version. Specifies whether the domain reports its version as 7.10 so that it continues to work with Elasticsearch OSS clients and plugins.

UpgradeDomainRequest.doc: Container for the request parameters to the UpgradeDomain operation.

UpgradeId.doc: The unique identifier of the domain upgrade.

DomainName.doc: The name of the domain that was upgraded.

TargetVersion.doc: OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version that the domain was upgraded to.

PerformCheckOnly.doc: When true, indicates that an upgrade eligibility check was performed.

AdvancedOptions.doc: The advanced options configuration for the domain.

ChangeProgressDetails.doc: Container for information about a configuration change happening on a domain.

UpgradeDomainResponse.doc: Container for the response returned by UpgradeDomain operation.

UpgradeName.doc: A string that describes the upgrade.

StartTimestamp.doc: UTC timestamp at which the upgrade API call was made, in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

UpgradeStatus.doc: The current status of the upgrade. The status can take one of the following values: In Progress Succeeded Succeeded with Issues Failed

StepsList.doc: A list of each step performed as part of a specific upgrade or upgrade eligibility check.

UpgradeHistory.doc: History of the last 10 upgrades and upgrade eligibility checks for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

UpgradeStep.doc: One of three steps that an upgrade or upgrade eligibility check goes through: PreUpgradeCheck Snapshot Upgrade

UpgradeStepStatus.doc: The current status of the upgrade. The status can take one of the following values: In Progress Succeeded Succeeded with Issues Failed

Issues.doc: A list of strings containing detailed information about the errors encountered in a particular step.

ProgressPercent.doc: The floating point value representing the progress percentage of a particular step.

UpgradeStepItem.doc: Represents a single step of an upgrade or upgrade eligibility check workflow.

Options.doc: The use case configured for the domain.

Status.doc: The current status of the use case for the domain.

UseCaseStatus.doc: The status of the use case for the domain.

VPCId.doc: The ID for your VPC. Amazon VPC generates this value when you create a VPC.

SubnetIds.doc: A list of subnet IDs associated with the VPC endpoints for the domain.

AvailabilityZones.doc: The list of Availability Zones associated with the VPC subnets.

SecurityGroupIds.doc: The list of security group IDs associated with the VPC endpoints for the domain.

EgressEnabled.doc: Indicates whether egress traffic from the domain is routed through the customer VPC. When true, outbound traffic flows through the VPC. When false, outbound traffic goes through the public internet.

VPCDerivedInfo.doc: Information about the subnets and security groups for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain provisioned within a virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information, see Launching your Amazon OpenSearch Service domains using a VPC. This information only exists if the domain was created with VPCOptions.

Options.doc: The VPC options for the specified domain.

Status.doc: The status of the VPC options for the specified domain.

VPCDerivedInfoStatus.doc: Status of the VPC options for a specified domain.

SubnetIds.doc: A list of subnet IDs associated with the VPC endpoints for the domain. If your domain uses multiple Availability Zones, you need to provide two subnet IDs, one per zone. Otherwise, provide only one.

SecurityGroupIds.doc: The list of security group IDs associated with the VPC endpoints for the domain. If you do not provide a security group ID, OpenSearch Service uses the default security group for the VPC.

EgressEnabled.doc: Controls whether egress traffic from the domain is routed through the customer VPC. When true, outbound traffic flows through the VPC. When false, outbound traffic goes through the public internet.

VPCOptions.doc: Options to specify the subnets and security groups for an Amazon OpenSearch Service VPC endpoint. For more information, see Launching your Amazon OpenSearch Service domains using a VPC.

Code.doc: The error code of the failure.

Message.doc: A message corresponding to the failure.

ValidationFailure.doc: A validation failure that occurred as the result of a pre-update validation check (verbose dry run) on a domain.

Options.doc: The OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version for the specified domain.

Status.doc: The status of the version options for the specified domain.

VersionStatus.doc: The status of the the OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version options for the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

VolumeType.doc: The type of EBS volume that a domain uses. For more information, see Configuring EBS-based storage.

VpcEndpointId.doc: The unique identifier of the endpoint.

DomainArn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain associated with the endpoint.

VpcOptions.doc: Options to specify the subnets and security groups for an Amazon OpenSearch Service VPC endpoint.

Status.doc: The current status of the endpoint.

Endpoint.doc: The connection endpoint ID for connecting to the domain.

VpcEndpoint.doc: The connection endpoint for connecting to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through a proxy.

VpcEndpointId.doc: The unique identifier of the endpoint.

ErrorCode.doc: The code associated with the error.

VpcEndpointError.doc: Error information when attempting to describe an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoint.

VpcEndpointId.doc: The unique identifier of the endpoint.

DomainArn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain associated with the endpoint.

Status.doc: The current status of the endpoint.

VpcEndpointSummary.doc: Summary information for an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoint.

Hours.doc: The start hour of the window in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), using 24-hour time. For example, 17 refers to 5:00 P.M. UTC.

Minutes.doc: The start minute of the window, in UTC.

WindowStartTime.doc: The desired start time for an off-peak maintenance window.

name.doc: The name of the workspace to create. Must be between 1 and 40 characters and can contain alphanumeric characters, parentheses, brackets, hyphens, underscores, and spaces.

workspaceType.doc: The type of workspace to create, which determines the use-case features enabled for the workspace. Valid values are OBSERVABILITY, SECURITY_ANALYTICS, and SEARCH.

WorkspaceConfigurationInput.doc: Configuration for creating a new workspace when attaching a data source to an OpenSearch application. The workspace is created after the data source is successfully attached.

AvailabilityZoneCount.doc: If you enabled multiple Availability Zones, this value is the number of zones that you want the domain to use. Valid values are 2 and 3. If your domain is provisioned within a VPC, this value be equal to number of subnets.

ZoneAwarenessConfig.doc: The zone awareness configuration for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.
